text:
Priya M.: Quick flag  morning invoice batch produced several anomalies: two customers received the same invoice_id and a handful of invoices show a support_credit line with negative totals applied twice.
Jonas B.: Oof. Any sample ids?
Priya M.: Samples: 2026-04-02-RW-5007 (duplicate invoice_id sent to two emails), 2026-04-02-RW-5012 (support_credit appears twice: -$25.00 each). Generated around 07:12-07:20 UTC.
Billing Bot: invoice-service ERROR: s3_put_conflict invoice_id=2026-04-02-RW-5007 key=inv/2026/04/02/2026-04-02-RW-5007.pdf status=409
Carrie S.: That double credit sounds similar to a join duplication. Did reconciler merge two partitions with the same reserved_credit row?
Priya M.: I pulled the reconciler CSV for customer redwood-pro and found two identical support_credit rows with same partition_id and same commit_hash: \n```
redwood-pro,2026-04-02,support_credit,qty=1,amount=-25.00,commit=ef12a3
redwood-pro,2026-04-02,support_credit,qty=1,amount=-25.00,commit=ef12a3
```
Jonas B.: That suggests a duplicate output from partition processor. Marco, any recent reconciler deploys or retry storms?
Marco S.: Reconciler v3.1.0 rolled at 07:05 UTC. I see a downstream SQS redrive for partition p-78 at 07:08 where a visibility timeout caused the same message to be reprocessed. The dedupe key uses (partition_id, run_id) but run_id was nil for that run due to a config glitch. PR to require run_id landed earlier today; we need to backfill run_ids for that window.
Priya M.: For the duplicate invoice_id: pdf-queue shows two enqueue events with different job_ids: \n```
pdf-queue INFO enqueue invoice_id=2026-04-02-RW-5007 job_id=job-442 generated_at=07:16:11
pdf-queue INFO enqueue invoice_id=2026-04-02-RW-5007 job_id=job-443 generated_at=07:16:42
```
Carrie S.: Did both PDFs go out to customers?
Priya M.: One email was sent (to billing@redwood-pro.com) and the other ended up queued but not delivered because our outbound-email pause rule blocked it. Still, S3 contains two objects with same key (one overwrote the previous put or caused a conflict depending on backend).
Billing Bot: audit-log: duplicate_invoice_detected invoice_id=2026-04-02-RW-5007 ticket=INV-4456
Jonas B.: Immediate mitigation: pause outbound emails and auto-finalize until we confirm no other dupes or double credits. Billing Bot, set outbound_email_paused=true and auto_finalize=false for 2h.
Billing Bot: command accepted: outbound_email_paused=true auto_finalize=false (expires in 120m) :white_check_mark:
Marco S.: Remediation plan: 
- Add a temporary SQL constraint to invoice_line_items to dedupe identical (invoice_id, line_code, commit_hash) rows for the affected window.
- Remove stale S3 object(s) for invoice_id=2026-04-02-RW-5007 and re-run pdf-gen from canonical reconciler output.
- Backfill run_id for reconciler runs between 07:00-07:30 UTC and re-run a dedupe pass.
Carrie S.: Also need customer comms. Priya can you draft a notice for redwood-pro explaining duplicate invoice and credit memo?
Priya M.: Will draft and post for review. Draft will include: cause (reconciler retry + missing run_id), correction steps, credit memo amount $25.00, and apology. Tagging @Jonas for approval.
Jonas B.: Approve once draft includes timeline and ETA for corrected invoice (ETA within 90 minutes).
Marco S.: I'll run the dedupe SQL now in dry-run, posting results in 15m. SQL I'm running: \n```
-- find exact duplicate line items
SELECT invoice_id, line_code, commit_hash, COUNT(*) as c
FROM invoice_line_items
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-02T07:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-02T07:30:00Z'
GROUP BY invoice_id, line_code, commit_hash
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
Priya M.: Also check for invoices where total != SUM(line_amount) to catch any silent miscalculations. SQL: \n```
SELECT i.invoice_id FROM invoices i
JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(line_amount) as lines_sum FROM invoice_line_items GROUP BY invoice_id) x
ON i.invoice_id = x.invoice_id
WHERE i.total_amount != x.lines_sum AND i.generated_at >= '2026-04-02T07:00:00Z';
```
Billing Bot: pager-alert condition set: duplicate_invoice_s3_puts > 1 in 15m -> page on-call billing-engineer (temporary)
Carrie S.: Anything else we should add? Maybe a short-term rollout freeze for reconciler changes until we've validated dedupe keys.
Marco S.: Agreed. I'll hold further reconciler deploys and ship a hotfix to require run_id plus an idempotency token on outputs. ETA 40m.
Jonas B.: Good. After Marco's patch and a successful dry-run dedupe, Priya proceed to regenerate PDFs and issue credit memo for affected customers. Keep outbound emails disabled until I sign off.
Priya M.: Will do. I'll post the draft external note here shortly. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
